thread:
Laura (docs): Quick sync — I ran through the v1->v2 migration guide and found 4 small but important SDK shim gotchas that could trip customers. Threading them here so we can decide quick fixes.
Mike (eng): Thanks Laura. Can you list them? I'll triage which are runtime vs docs.
Laura (docs): 1) `Client.replaceModel` examples still show the old param name `model_name` (v1). v2 uses `model` and also expects a `version` key in some SDKs. 2) Snippet shows `stream: true` but doesn't include the streaming handler example. 3) Link to the model mapping doc goes to an old anchor that 404s. 4) Note about tokenization: we mention `byte_pair` tokenizer — pretty sure our SDKs expose `tokenizer.encode` signatures differently now.
Sam (DevEx): Oof. For (1) we should add a small compat note and example of the compat shim: `const client = new Client({legacyNames: true}) // only for short-term` — but we can't advertise a private flag. Maybe better to show the explicit rename in examples.
Chris (SDK): We don't have `{legacyNames}` in the public SDK. Please don't add that. We can add a small wrapper snippet users can paste:
```js
// quick compat shim
function wrap(client) {
  return {
    replaceModel(opts) { return client.replace({model: opts.model_name, version: opts.version}) }
  }
}
```
Priya (PM): From product POV we should push customers to the canonical v2 shape. But docs should show a migration appendix with both the v1->v2 mapping table and small copy-paste shims like Chris suggested.
Laura (docs): Agreed. I'll draft an appendix. For (2) streaming — currently examples in ts SDK show `onToken` in an older callback style. We should either show the new async iterator pattern or both. Which do we prefer?
Mike (eng): New async iterator pattern is preferred. Add an end-to-end snippet with `for await (const chunk of client.streaming.generate(...))` and then a short note: "older callback style supported in 0.x, prefer iterator in 1.x+."
Sam (DevEx): I'll add one-liners to the quickstart so users see streaming pattern quickly. Also will add a playground link.
Laura (docs): Link issues: the model map link currently goes to `/docs/models/mapping#legacy-maps` which we removed. Suggested replace -> `/docs/model-catalog/mapping-v2#model-compat`. Anyone confirm the new anchor exists?
Chris (SDK): Yes `/docs/model-catalog/mapping-v2#model-compat` is the new path. I'll add a redirect rule in the docs site config but we should fix the link ASAP.
Priya (PM): Legal asked to remove the word "unsupported" for some older model variants; use "deprecated" instead. Can docs make language change globally for migration pages?
Laura (docs): Will replace instances in the migration guide. Search/replace across repo OK? I can open a PR with the changes + a migration appendix. Any objections?
Mike (eng): Fine by me. Add a short note under "Known behavioral diffs" about KV cache semantics — some customers rely on older TTL behavior.
Sam (DevEx): Also: add a small checklist at top: "Before you swap models in prod" — include 1) run eval suite, 2) confirm latency SLO on dedicated, 3) validate token accounting.
Laura (docs): I'll create a single PR that: updates snippets (param rename + streaming iterator), fixes the link to mapping-v2, replaces language to "deprecated", and adds migration appendix + checklist. Assigning reviewers: @Chris (SDK), @Mike (Eng), @Sam (DevEx). Estimated PR size small (doc + 3 snippets + 1 redirect).
Chris (SDK): I'll review today. If you add a code block that uses `for await` please include the TS import example to avoid confusion.
Laura (docs): Good call. Also adding a tiny test harness in the doc to exercise the snippet via the docs-ci (so we don't drift).
Docs-Bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/872 — Laura updated migration guide, streaming snippet, and model-mapping link. CI checks running. :github: 
Sam (DevEx): Reviewing now. Quick note — can we also add a small line in the changelog (v2 GA) referencing this migration appendix so customers see it in the release notes?
Priya (PM): Yes please — add to release notes. I'll include a short blurb in the GA email.
Laura (docs): Done. I'll ping back when CI is green and link is verified. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup: 
Mike (eng): Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.
